\begin{tikzpicture}[line width=1pt,>=latex]
  \begin{scope}[tips=never]
    \draw[blue,<->,shorten <=5pt,shorten >=7pt] (0,0) -- (2,0);
    \draw[red,<->,/pgf/tips=true] (0,-.35) -- (2,-.35);
  \end{scope}
  \draw[teal,<->,tips=false] (0,-.7) -- (2,-.7);
  \draw[purple,<->] (0,-1.05) -- (2,-1.05);
  \begin{scope}[gray,<->,shorten >=5pt]
    \draw[clip] (0,-1.4) -- (2,-1.4);
  \end{scope}
\end{tikzpicture}
